name: dock
description: Container stacks per worktree: a pixel-art pane of every compose stack with its memory and worktree, orphans whose worktree is gone, and a guard that asks before booting another stack when memory headroom is low.

intervalSeconds.title: Pane refresh (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: How often the /dock pane reads docker again while it is open. Nothing is read while it is closed.

guard.title: Guard stack boots
guard.description: Before a Bash `docker compose up` or `docker-compose up`, read docker and ask first when the memory headroom is below the minimum.

minHeadroomGiB.title: Minimum headroom (GiB)
minHeadroomGiB.description: Free engine memory, in GiB, below which the guard asks before another stack boots.
